notes.title: Ear Protection
notes.content:
Added:
- Music toggle on/off button in the gameplay menu.
- Experimental support for MacOS users.
Changed:
- Stonks now have a higher chance to increase in price.
- Nukes have a negative impact on the stonks market.
- The "Crash Stonks Market" item in the black market now has a greater impact on the stonks market.
- Nukes improve stats like workers, effort, and clicks.
